sense.evidence: "doubled down on the FOMC's policy" adds intensification to reaffirming an existing policy; most terms otherwise preserve their intended sense.

authenticity.evidence: "done and dusted" and "put it in black and white" fit local speech, but "give the tick to" is an awkward version of the usual idiom.
